title: Elijah & Elisha, Part 1 — title slide
summary: Opening title slide for the Elijah and Elisha series, Part 1: a video still of the presenter roasting a marshmallow by a fireplace in front of a world map. The shared first letters of the two names (E, l, i) are coloured alike.

pictures.description: The presenter, a grey-haired man in glasses and a white T-shirt, sits in a brown leather armchair holding a flaming marshmallow on a long stick, with a large world map on the wall behind him and a fireplace with burning logs to his left. A vase of decorative stems stands at the far left.
pictures.text_in_picture: Elijah / Elisha / Part 1; Hard Rock Cafe (T-shirt logo)
